ANYTHING CONVERTER {0} · TERMINAL · HELP

KEYS
  tab / shift+tab   next / previous field
  arrows + enter    choose in lists, folders and tabs
  ctrl+s            start (on the current tab)
  ctrl+o            type or paste a path
  ctrl+t            change colour (green, amber, cyan, white)
  f1 or ?           this help          ctrl+q   quit
  1 to 9, 0         go to tab 1-10 (when not in a text field)

TIPS
  · drag a file into the terminal window to paste its path
  · results go next to the original; nothing is ever overwritten
  · CUE/BIN: choose the .cue, the .bin files in the same folder are included
  · patch a ROM: choose the ROM and enter the .ips/.ups/.bps file at PATCH>
  · copy text from the text box with ctrl+c (also works over SSH in most terminals)

OTHER WAYS
  anything-converter-tui --simple     numbered menus, works in any terminal
  anything-converter-tui --ascii      ASCII characters only (old consoles)
  anything-converter-tui --help       commands for scripts, e.g.
      anything-converter-tui convert *.heic --to jpg
